title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1973-11-17

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a late‑'73 masterpiece, highlighted by the blazing Playing → Uncle John’s Band → Morning Dew suite and a soaring Here Comes Sunshine.
ai_review.review: The remastered soundboard is described as crisp, bright and virtually flawless, letting listeners hear every nuance of the band’s jazzy, tightly‑locked playing.  Highlights include the legendary second‑set suite (Playing > Uncle John’s Band > Morning Dew > Uncle John’s Band > Playing), a fiery Here Comes Sunshine, and a superb China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition.  Overall the performance is hailed as one of the era’s top shows with seamless segues and exuberant energy.

ai_rating.rationale: All 23 reviews are 5‑star, uniformly praising both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard remaster; the consensus indicates an exceptional show with excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the remaster ‘pristine’, ‘crisp’, ‘bright’ and note that any early‑set bass is less prominent but quickly balances; no significant flaws reported.

standout_songs: Playing > Uncle John’s Band > Morning Dew > Uncle John’s Band > Playing
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its tightness, seamless transitions (especially the Playing suite) and a jazzy, improvisational feel that keeps the momentum high from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his soaring lead guitar—particularly on China‑Rider and throughout the jam suites.
band_member_comments.Phil: Initially less prominent in the mix but quickly finds its place; overall bass work is solid.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s playing is highlighted as leading the band into New Orleans‑style jazz, with his organ adding bristling, bubbling textures.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (Mickey) is noted as tight and prominent in the mix, driving the energetic grooves.
